description: This file contains an extension for the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, defining various UI and session management functions related to voice wake overlay sessions, such as starting, updating, finalizing, canceling, dismissing sessions, and handling UI states and interactions.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new voice wake overlay session with provided parameters, setting internal state and presenting the overlay.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current session state info as a tuple including token, source, text, and visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with a partial transcript, canceling any auto-send task and updating UI state.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the session, optionally schedules an auto-send after a delay, updates state, and logs details.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Marks that the user has started editing, canceling any auto-send operation.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels editing state and dismisses the overlay with an explicit reason.

methods.name: endEditing
methods.description: Ends editing mode without dismissing the overlay.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay's transcript text, resets sending state, and updates UI.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Changes overlay state to indicate sending, optionally plays a chime, and dismisses after a short delay.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests to send the current transcript via the session coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay with animation, resets internal state, and triggers associated side effects.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the input power level indicator in the overlay if the level has changed sufficiently.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an automatic send after a specified delay, handling task cancellation and timing.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from text with standard styling for display.
